devices.docs:
**list**: A list of devices to configure.

*See also: [USB Host Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_host#configuration-variables)*

enable_hubs.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to include support for hubs. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [USB Host Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_host#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: An id to assign to the device.

*See also: [USB Host Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_host#configuration-variables)*

max_packet_size.docs:
**int**: Maximum USB packet size in bytes. Defaults to `64` (USB Full Speed). Valid option values are 64, 128, 256, 512 and 1024. Intended for use with USB-HS capable devices like the ESP32-P4.

*See also: [USB Host Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_host#configuration-variables)*

max_transfer_requests.docs:
**int**: Maximum number of concurrent USB transfer requests. Range: 1-32. Defaults to `16`. Increase this value for high-throughput devices (e.g., USB UART at 115200+ baud) if you see "All X transfer slots in use" errors.

*See also: [USB Host Interface](https://esphome.io/components/usb_host#configuration-variables)*
